thread:
maria_cs: FYI CloudRidge onboarding hit a blocker — egress to ap-southeast is blocked by their infra. They're demoing Monday, asking for a short allowlist + temporary qps bump so the demo doesn't fail. renewal health is a bit shaky (low usage) so want to avoid a bad first impression. Can we do a quick exception? :warning:

 tom_ops: Do we have the CIDRs and target QPS window? Also how long they need it for? We should auto-revoke.

 maria_cs: CIDRs they gave: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25. Asking for +2x baseline QPS for 72 hours starting 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. They only need APAC (ap-southeast). Demo attendees ~40.

 sanjay_eng: Capacity check — 2x for 72h looks fine on dedicated pool if we route to apac-canary. Suggest: create allowlist entry, route their traffic to dedicated-canary-apac, and set an automatic revoke TTL. Also enable request-level audit logging for compliance.

 tom_ops: Sounds good. Proposed internal steps: 1) add CIDRs to customer allowlist (ap-southeast) 2) create transient rate-plan: multiplier=2 duration=72h 3) pin route to dedicated-canary-apac 4) enable auto-revoke+audit. I'll run the change if ops-bot ok.

 maria_cs: Customer ok with auto-revoke. They've signed off on short window and audit. They're worried about renewal so Elaine, can we fast-track a follow-up enablement in the week after the demo? Capture feedback + success metrics.

 elaine_pm: Yes — I'll book a 30min enablement/feedback call for Wed after the demo. We'll run a short checklist: success criteria, performance numbers, blockers, and next steps for scaling. I'll also flag renewal for CSM outreach if demo goes well. :calendar:

 tom_ops: Preparing commands now. Will apply at start window. Config snippet I'll use: ```json
{
  "customer": "cloudridge",
  "region": "ap-southeast",
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25"],
  "rate_plan": {"multiplier": 2, "duration_hours": 72},
  "route": "dedicated-canary-apac",
  "auto_revoke": "2026-04-05T08:00:00Z",
  "audit": true
}
```

 ops-bot: Change request CS-4231 created by tom_ops for customer=cloudridge. Pending manual approval from eng-oncall.

 tom_ops: eng-oncall approved via thread. Applying now. Will post update when done. :hammer_and_wrench:

 ops-bot: Change CS-4231 applied — allowlist entries created and transient rate-plan active. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-05T08:00:00Z.

 sanjay_eng: Routing confirmed to dedicated-canary-apac. Monitor tip: watch tail latency and token throughput; if latency > 300ms for 2 consecutive minutes, fallback to hosted-std to keep demo live. I'll add the fallback policy.

 tom_ops: Fallback policy in place. CloudRidge notified and demo link tested end-to-end :white_check_mark:. I'll keep watch during the demo and escalate if we see anomalies.

 maria_cs: Amazing, thanks team. I'll run enablement notes and send calendar invite. After demo I'll capture feedback and update renewal risk in CRM. :rocket:

 elaine_pm: I'll prep a short feedback form and NPS question for follow-up. If they hit the success criteria we'll open a renewal play and propose monthly committed capacity.

 maria_cs: Closing loop — demo scheduled and running under the temporary config. Will update thread after post-demo call. Thanks everyone. :heart:
